headline: Two six-week tests from Pavol's 7 Nov 'After the App' marks start today. Test A (sell the result) is live (#31): a learner can enter an exam date that stays on the device, and the day after it the app asks once 'Jak dopadla zkouška?', sending the answer with the readiness bucket. Test B (technical submissions) is research and drafts only: none of the 8 places found takes a plain form without Pavol's name or email, so nothing was submitted.

tests.name: A: sell the result
tests.stop_rule: Stop if, by 2026-12-19, there are fewer than 30 real results, or readiness predicts pass/fail with an AUC below 0.7. Count only passed/failed answers whose readiness_bucket is not 'none'.

event_switch.what: From the deploy of #34 on 2026-11-07 (after the orchestrator read allow-list v4 back at 16:27 UTC), answers are sent as exam_result_reported {result, readiness_bucket}. Before that deploy, the same answers were sent as key_action {action:'exam_result_reported', result, readiness_bucket}.
event_switch.reading: The reading on 2026-12-19 must count both names: exam_result_reported events, plus key_action events whose action is 'exam_result_reported'. Remove duplicates by visitor.
event_switch.note: flywheel's data/signals/allowlist.json (v4) still lists exam_result_reported under 'pending'. The orchestrator reported the live policy accepts it, so flywheel should remove it from 'pending'. The vendored copy here is unchanged.

tests.name: B: distribution through technical submissions only
tests.pavol_words: Test this through technical submissions, I am still uneasy posting on social media, but the email to the Met and Danish museum was great because it was in response to their call for sharing.
tests.stop_rule: Stop if, by 2026-12-19, AI search still finds Autoškola in 0 of 14 queries and visitors rose by less than 20 %.
tests.drafts: docs/outreach/2026-11-07.md: A answers MŠMT Na dálku's call for 'návrhy k doplnění' (nadalku@msmt.cz); B is to Asociace autoškol ČR. A proposal on an open licence is needed for NPI's open-resource nomination, and listing text is ready for directory accounts.
tests.baselines: AI search 0 of 14 (the AIO baseline from 2026-10-28). The visitor and referring-domain baselines for the week before 2026-11-07 must be taken by the platform session: this repo has no data access and runs no Supabase SQL.

shipped.title: Test A, sell the result: exam date on the device, then once "Jak dopadla zkouška?"
shipped.live_checked: 2026-11-07 ~05:15Z on the deployed site at 390 px (cs-CZ). A date entered in "Termín zkoušky" was still there after a reload, and nothing was asked before the date. With the date set to yesterday, "Jak dopadla zkouška?" showed with Složil(a) / Nesložil(a) / Ještě ne, with no horizontal overflow. No answer was clicked, so no test event entered the real test A data, and the check cleaned up its storage. Answering and the event are covered by the unit, RTL and e2e tests.

decisions.question: The event name exam_result_reported is not on the allow-list yet
decisions.why: The database drops unlisted names. key_action is accepted today and carries the same props.

decisions.question: When is the result asked?
options: on every visit after the date until answered
decisions.default_taken: on every visit after the date until answered
decisions.why: A learner who skips the card on that visit would otherwise give no result. 'Ještě ne' ends it for that date, and a new date asks again after it.

decisions.question: Which date does an answer belong to?
options: the date it was asked about
the date set when the button is tapped
decisions.default_taken: the date it was asked about
decisions.why: Found by the independent review: a retake date typed before answering would otherwise make the app never ask about the retake.

decisions.question: Readiness at what moment?
decisions.why: No readiness history is stored. The card sits at the top of Home, so the gap is usually small; the analysis should note it.

decisions.question: What counts as a 'technical submission' Claude may make alone?
options: only forms needing no account, payment, public post, or Pavol's name or email
also forms asking for a contact email
decisions.default_taken: only forms needing no account, payment, public post, or Pavol's name or email
decisions.why: A contact email is Pavol's name on the request. None of the 8 places met the bar, so all became drafts. Search engines already get every URL through flywheel's central IndexNow job.

decisions.question: The ad-fontes e2e failed now and then
decisions.why: Root cause: it answered a random Pravidla provozu question, and some explanations rightly cite no law. It now opens a fixed question. Test change only.

proposals: An open licence (e.g. CC BY 4.0) on the explanations, so the trainer can be nominated to NPI's national open-resource database on RVP.CZ. Competitors could then reuse the explanations too. This changes what the product is, so it is Pavol's call; details are in docs/outreach/2026-11-07.md.
for_pavol: Two drafts to send if you like them: MŠMT Na dálku (answers their call for additions) and Asociace autoškol ČR. Five older drafts from 2026-10-30 are still waiting.
Directory listings (AlternativeTo, SaaSHub) need an account in your name; listing text is ready.
next: Platform session: add exam_result_reported to allow-list v4 (Pavol approves the database rule), then switch the one line from key_action.
Platform session: take the visitor and referring-domain baselines for the week before 2026-11-07, and run the weekly AI-search count for the 14 queries.
On 2026-12-19: compute the AUC of readiness_bucket against passed/failed (non-'none' only, one answer per visitor) and apply both stop rules.
